definition: Annual government funding to direct research programmes and institutions by recipient and measure
italy_data_requirement: Measure-recipient-year funding and accounting stage
notes: Keep appropriations commitments payments and beneficiary expenditure separate

definition: Intramural Frascati R&D actually performed by public and higher education performers
italy_data_requirement: HERD_GOVERD_PNP by year and source
notes: Not equivalent to public funding or GBARD

definition: Direct grants and support received by firms for eligible R&D
italy_data_requirement: Firm/measure/recipient-year grant receipt and eligible costs
notes: Separate amount paid from eligible R&D expenditure and induced R&D

definition: Government tax relief for R&D expenditure measured as fiscal cost
italy_data_requirement: GTARD and scheme-level tax expenditure
notes: Not a measure of R&D performed

definition: Price/user-cost index for a marginal unit of business R&D incorporating tax system and incentive design
italy_data_requirement: Construct B-index by firm type and year
notes: Prefer to simple tax-credit dummy where tax and firm data permit

definition: Subsidy rate reducing the effective cost of researcher labour in business R&D
italy_data_requirement: Scheme-level eligible researcher wage subsidy and recipient wages
notes: Closest mapping to B3 s_RD; do not use for PRIN

definition: Support reducing fixed costs or user cost of intangible R&D investment in model-specific structures
italy_data_requirement: Project-level R&D costs and instrument terms
notes: RTDI may exceed Frascati boundary

definition: Productive capital stock attributable to research infrastructure and operational R&D use
italy_data_requirement: Capex commissioning operational date capacity and actual R&D use
notes: Construction allocation is not R&D expenditure

definition: Researchers and high-skilled labour supply by sector and skill/qualification
italy_data_requirement: Researchers FTE by sector qualification and age
notes: Separate training costs from R&D performance

definition: Total intramural R&D performed in Italy under Frascati definition
italy_data_requirement: GERD series with source vintage and price metadata
notes: Core benchmark and aggregate outcome not policy shock

definition: Intramural business enterprise R&D expenditure
italy_data_requirement: BERD annual series by source and type
notes: Do not confuse sector performer with source of finance

definition: Intramural higher education R&D expenditure
italy_data_requirement: HERD by funding source type and costs
notes: Universities may perform research funded by multiple sectors

definition: Intramural government-sector R&D expenditure
italy_data_requirement: GOVERD by funding source type and costs
notes: Government funder and government performer are distinct concepts

definition: GERD cross-classified by performer sector and source of funds
italy_data_requirement: Full performer-by-funder matrix where available
notes: Supports domestic/public-financed distinction and prevents double counting

definition: basic_research_applied_research_experimental_development
italy_data_requirement: By sector and source where available
notes: Direct grants may affect research type mix differently from tax incentives

definition: researcher_labour_other_current_and_capital_costs
italy_data_requirement: Cost breakdown by sector and type
notes: Needed to distinguish labour and intangible investment channels

definition: R&D researchers measured as full-time equivalents/person-years by performing sector
italy_data_requirement: Annual researcher FTE by performer sector
notes: Preferred to headcount for R&D labour quantity

definition: Number of persons employed in R&D by sector
italy_data_requirement: Annual headcount by performer sector
notes: Retain alongside FTE to detect part-time/relabeling effects

definition: Accumulated public R&D capital/knowledge stock built from public R&D flows
italy_data_requirement: Public R&D flows plus depreciation and deflator
notes: Publish sensitivity to PIM depreciation and price indices

definition: Accumulated private/business R&D capital/knowledge stock built from BERD flows
italy_data_requirement: BERD flows plus depreciation and deflator
notes: Keep separate from public R&D stock

definition: Foreign public R&D capital stock weighted by bilateral or technological exposure
italy_data_requirement: OECD partner public R&D stocks and weights
notes: Not Italian domestic R&D

definition: Foreign private R&D capital stock weighted by exposure
italy_data_requirement: OECD partner BERD stocks and weights
notes: Not Italian domestic R&D

definition: Patent applications grants and citations attributed to resident inventors/assignees
italy_data_requirement: Patent family and inventor residence crosswalk
notes: Lagged/noisy output indicator not a substitute for R&D expenditure

definition: Total factor productivity consistent with national accounts methodology
italy_data_requirement: ISTAT/OECD productivity series and vintage
notes: Model outcome/state; ensure labour quality and capital consistency

definition: Real GDP and industry value added in consistent national accounts vintage
italy_data_requirement: ISTAT national accounts series
notes: Outcome/control; choose GDP or sectoral VA according to model

definition: Real productive physical capital stock
italy_data_requirement: National accounts gross fixed capital formation and depreciation
notes: Separate from research capital and infrastructure policy impulse

definition: Skill-adjusted labour or human capital index
italy_data_requirement: Education/skills data harmonised with labour series
notes: Do not substitute doctoral programme spending

definition: Productive public infrastructure capital stock
italy_data_requirement: Public GFCF and depreciation with infrastructure classification
notes: Not automatically research infrastructure or R&D

definition: Intramural firm R&D expenditure and cost components by firm-year
italy_data_requirement: ISTAT R&D survey and secure administrative linkages
notes: Microdata access and confidentiality likely constrain availability

definition: Grant/tax support receipt amount eligibility and timing by firm-year
italy_data_requirement: RNA/ReGiS/tax data linked by stable firm ID
notes: Correct selection/endogeneity and overlaps

definition: Firm size industry age productivity profitability baseline R&D and ownership
italy_data_requirement: Linked firm accounts and R&D survey
notes: Use stable firm IDs and time-varying sector classifications

definition: Regional/sectoral exposure to university research and research cooperation
italy_data_requirement: University research spend and geographic/technology proximity
notes: Potential mechanism/control not direct business R&D funding

definition: Instrument-specific net additional R&D relative to explicit no-policy counterfactual
italy_data_requirement: Measure/firm counterfactual and causal design
notes: No universal coefficient; report uncertainty and gross/net definitions

definition: Annual mapping from policy commitment/payment to beneficiary R&D performance
italy_data_requirement: Measure and project-year reporting plus commissioning
notes: Separate budget cash year from R&D performance year

definition: Dynamic interaction between public and private domestic R&D stocks or flows
italy_data_requirement: Public_private R&D stocks and additional private response to public R&D
notes: Do not impose a universal complementarity coefficient

definition: Share of basic research in total R&D by performer and funding source
italy_data_requirement: Annual R&D type breakdown by sector and funding source
notes: Potential complementarity/spillover descriptor not an expenditure addition

definition: Share of business R&D performed in Italy financed from abroad
italy_data_requirement: BERD source-of-funds matrix including foreign sources
notes: Important for domestic capture and internationalisation; do not count as foreign-performed R&D

definition: R&D expenditure or stock by industry relative to value added or sales
italy_data_requirement: BERD by NACE industry and industry value added
notes: Needed for sector-specific elasticities and nonlinear returns

definition: Firm/sector own R&D base and high-skilled researcher capacity that mediate use of external knowledge
italy_data_requirement: Own R&D intensity researcher FTE and skill mix
notes: Micro/sector satellite; not a direct public policy input

definition: Exposure of firms/sectors to public research knowledge by patent-class overlap citations or proximity
italy_data_requirement: Link public research outputs to firm patent technology fields and geography
notes: Requires microdata and matching; not mandatory national macro series

definition: High-technology imports and exports as knowledge diffusion/technology adoption proxies
italy_data_requirement: High-tech trade series by product/industry and trade partner
notes: Control/technology diffusion channel not R&D expenditure

definition: Inward and outward FDI stocks or flows relevant to technology and knowledge transfer
italy_data_requirement: FDI stocks by sector and source/destination
notes: Potential productivity control; not R&D funding or domestic R&D
